title: A new Geometric Setting for the Analysis of Partial Differential Equations
summary: In this paper, we introduce a hybrid metric geometry on the space of absolutely continuous probability densities that combines optimal transport (Wasserstein geometry) and log-ratio composition (Aitchison geometry). The hybrid distance $D_α$ is defined through a Benamou--Brenier-type dynamical formulation that couples spatial transport with a centered reaction term preserving total mass.We prove that $D_α$ is a genuine metric and establish comparison estimates with the Wasserstein and Aitchison distances.
